text: When the seas of the world are replaced by blood, and the mountains of the world are shrouded by mounds of the slain, our glory shall be made manifest.
Even the most casual glance is enough to shatter the courage of enemies on the field, as if their very souls were torn from their flesh.
This is our hunting ground, countless prey awaiting slaughter, and we are the singers of blood!
